data.desc: J and Friends Holdings Limited (Formerly, Pintec Technology Holdings Limited) is a Nasdaq-listed technology company dedicated to delivering innovative financial and digital solutions to micro, small, and medium enterprises worldwide. Through its open platform, J and Friends Holdings Limited connects business partners and financial institutions, enabling them to provide efficient, technology-driven services to end users across international markets. By empowering partners with embedded financing capabilities and advanced digital tools, J and Friends Holdings Limited helps businesses expand their offerings and supports financial institutions in reaching new customer segments in the digital economy.
